label: Higgsfield
description: Higgsfield AI API — 83 image and video models (Soul, Seedance, Kling, Wan, Hailuo, PixVerse, LTX, Genjutsu, Recraft, Ideogram…): text/image/reference to video, picture generation and editing, video edit/extend, motion transfer, restyle, object swap and Soul ID characters. Agent tools plus workflow nodes.

settings.sections.title: Higgsfield
settings.sections.description: Paste your Higgsfield API key as KEY_ID:KEY_SECRET (console.higgsfield.ai → API keys). Stored encrypted on this device. Powers the higgsfield_* tools and the Higgsfield workflow nodes. Generations use your API credit balance (pay as you go; failed and moderated requests are refunded).

steps.title: Paste your API key
steps.body: Create a key at console.higgsfield.ai → API keys, paste it here as KEY_ID:KEY_SECRET, then hit Test. Tools appear as higgsfield_* once this plugin is on.

steps.title: Pictures and videos
steps.body: Ask a ducky for a video or picture, or open Workflows: the Higgsfield group has Text/Image/Reference to Video, Text to Image, Edit Image, Edit Video, Motion Transfer, Restyle, Object Swap and Any Model. Paid steps only run with Spend credits on, and agents ask you first with the price.
